name: Pundi AI uninitialized swap proxy takeover
summary: Pundi AI deployed its FXSwap ERC1967 proxy with empty init data, leaving initialize(address,address) open. In the next block the attacker initialized it, took ownership and upgraded it to a pass-through backdoor; months later it used the proxy's minter role to mint one million unbacked PUNDIAI and sold them.
notes: Anchored on the attacker's initializer call (rule 10); the installed backdoor is part of the attack. The mint is listed in campaign. The deployer's own initialize in block 21892133 ran against the attacker's code and is not an exploit.

Minted PUNDIAI could not be absorbed by its markets, so it is valued at the attacker's realised proceeds (rule 12): WETH and USDT on Ethereum (net of 10 USDT it supplied) and BSC-USD on BSC from PancakeSwap v3 and f(x) bridge payouts. The 446k PUNDIAI the team burned is not subtracted.
